name: The Soap Bubble Telescope
description: A child's toy telescope made of iridescent soap bubbles that, when looked through, reveals entire worlds contained within each floating bubble, with miniature cities and landscapes visible inside.
prompt: Children's toy telescope constructed from iridescent soap bubbles, looking through reveals miniature worlds inside each floating bubble, tiny cities and landscapes visible within, rainbow light refraction, playful atmosphere, detailed bubble physics, fantasy microscopic worlds
caption: Through a bubble's gaze, infinite universes unfold. What world would you discover? 🫧🔭
